label_access_policy.early_artifacts: identity and scalar transport fields only; no TEST responses or outcomes

label_access_policy.test: Exp9063 final_evaluation only after byte-bound Exp9061 and Exp9062 prediction seals; no early truth reads

online_contract.claim_scope: fixed-basis coefficient learning mechanics only; not structural knot adaptation or importance-weighted replay
online_contract.cost_boundary: Dense anchoring and guard scan cost work beyond the local spline gradient. No inference-speed or FPGA gain follows from fixtures.
fixed: temperature=1 for methods fixtures; downstream temperature frozen once before online

state_schema.feedback_rows: consumed labels and pre-read prediction hash
state_schema.promotion_rows: candidate and committed hashes plus guard decision
state_schema.request_hash: fixed public inputs and label location

ten_bound_contract.method: one-sided percentile upper, linear quantile, Bonferroni ten bounds
ten_bound_contract.retention_resampling: same graph-ID draw across streams and checkpoints; independent of stream draw

update_equations: p=mean_s sigmoid(phi_s @ theta_s), s=71,72,73; one ensemble sample per query
g=gradient(L) on allowed coefficients; g/=max(1,norm(g)) over the whole three-state vector
A+=g*g; theta-=0.05*g/sqrt(A+1e-8); A_initial=0; one update per released label
after four labels: promote iff original64 guard Brier increase<=0.005 and error increase<=0 relative to arm initial; otherwise restore theta and A; always acknowledge labels
